title: Ledger 2 — Decision/gate (why was this permitted?)
description: arch §5 L2 + §7.3: every proposed action + permit/deny verdict + policy version in force at execution. Same artifact as the action manifest. Mainline S1: 'gate passed' and 'posture narrowed' are distinct recorded outcomes.

proposed_action.description: The action as proposed, before the verdict (gate-verdict field set — load-bearing, must-map)

action_class.description: Action category (read / write / send / execute / schedule) — the envelope's (FK6b) unit

target.description: Target of the action (path, recipient, URL, resource)

payload_digest.description: Hash of the full payload; payload stored by reference, inspected by the gate (FR2 payload inspection)

policy_version.description: Version of the policy/rule set in force at execution (load-bearing, must-map — the EU AI Act traceability core, arch §5.2)

inspection.description: Payload-inspection result (FR2: the gate looks inside the action)

outcome.description: Distinct from verdict: what actually happened. A miss converts to a narrowing only as an explicit logged decision, never silently (mainline S1 / A-FK2)

taint_tier.description: Trust tier of sources touched by the session at decision time (arch §7.7, session-granular in the fork)

posture.description: Run posture in force (attended / unattended-guarded / unattended-allowlisted) — R-13
